about.title: About The Event
paragraphs: Agnel Polytechnic Vashi's E-Cell proudly unveils Pitchnova, a dynamic pitching competition designed to ignite innovation and entrepreneurial spirit among aspiring changemakers.

Scheduled for 24th August 2026, Pitchnova 2.0 welcomes students, startups, and innovators from across all educational backgrounds, be it Polytechnic, Degree, MBA, or any other field, to present their groundbreaking ideas.
Participants will form teams of 1 to 4 members and submit their unique presentations using the prescribed template.

Each team will take the stage to deliver a concise, powerful 2 minute pitch, showcasing their creativity, problem solving abilities, and communication skills. This will be followed by a 3 minute Q&A session with a panel of judges to probe deeper into their concepts.

items.title: Registration Deadline
items.description: All teams must complete their registration by 22nd August 2026.

items.title: Team Composition
items.description: Teams may consist of 1 to 4 members. All team members must be from the same college or institution.

items.title: Pitch Deck Submission
items.description: Every participating team must prepare their pitch deck in PPT format, adhering to the template provided by APV E-CELL.

items.title: Registration Fee
items.description: ₹100 per person.

items.title: Registration Requirement
items.description: Teams that fail to complete the Eureka! registration with the proper referral by the deadline will be automatically disqualified from the competition.

items.title: No Refund Policy
items.description: Registration fees are non-refundable under any circumstances.

items.title: Pitching Session
items.description: Each team will have 2 minutes to present their startup idea, followed by a 3-minute Q&A session with the jury.

items.title: Number of Finalists
items.description: Top 3 teams will be selected based on their pitches and get a chance to participate directly in the Zonal rounds of the Eureka! Pitching Competition.

items.title: Judging Criteria
items.description: Startups will be evaluated according to parameters such as innovation, market potential, business viability, team capability, and overall presentation quality. Detailed judging criteria will be shared during orientation.

items.title: Pitch Deck Requirements
items.description: The pitch deck should cover, but is not limited to, the problem statement, solution or product overview, target market, business model, competitive advantage, team, and financial projections.

items.title: Team Representation
items.description: Only one team per startup idea will be allowed. Each member can participate in only one team.

items.title: Attendance
items.description: All registered participants are required to attend the event in its entirety.

items.title: Incubation Opportunities
items.description: Opportunities to take your ideas further through incubation support.

items.title: Networking Opportunities
items.description: Build relationships and connect with fellow contestants and aspiring changemakers.

items.title: Chance to Compete in Eureka!
items.description: Top-performing teams get a chance to compete in the Eureka! Pitching Competition.

items.title: Trophies & Certificates
items.description: Every team member receives a certificate, with trophies for top performers.

items.title: Website Launch
items.description: Launch of the E-Cell website with event details, schedules and participant information.

items.title: Registration Deadline
items.description: All students who wish to participate in Pitchnova must register and fill the form by the deadline to be eligible.

items.title: Online Orientation
items.description: Teams will be guided through the Pitchnova process, including registration on the Eureka! website using APV E-Cell's NEC ID.

items.title: Pitchnova 2.0
items.description: The show day where startups, students and graduates compete by pitching their ideas to a panel of judges.
